id: \rFinally. No one ever picks my door.
en: \rFinally. No one ever picks my door.
it: \rFinalmente. Nessuno sceglie mai la mia porta.

id: \rI've only faced thirty two challengers since working here. Everyone else has more.
en: \rI've only faced thirty two challengers since working here. Everyone else has more.
it: \rDa quando lavoro qui ho affrontato solo trentadue sfidanti. Tutti gli altri ne hanno di più.

id: \rWell try again. You can never be too careful.
en: \rWell try again. You can never be too careful.
it: \rBeh, riprova. La prudenza non è mai troppa.

id: \bFantina uses Ghost type Pokémon. They are weak against the Dark and Ghost types.
en: \bFantina uses Ghost type Pokémon. They are weak against the Dark and Ghost types.
it: \bFannie usa Pokémon di tipo Spettro. Sono deboli contro i tipi Buio e Spettro.

id: \bThey are strong against Ghost and Psychic. They are resistant to Bug and Poison and are immune to Normal and Fighting types.
en: \bThey are strong against Ghost and Psychic. They are resistant to Bug and Poison and are immune to Normal and Fighting types.
it: \bSono superefficaci contro Spettro e Psico. Resistono a Coleottero e Veleno e sono immuni ai tipi Normale e Lotta.
\bLa strada verso la vittoria è dura.

id: \rSince coming to this region I have learned many things. This is the reason I so often travel. Can you teach me anything new?
en: \rSince coming to this region I have learned many things. This is the reason I so often travel. Can you teach me anything new?
it: \rDa quando sono venuta in questa regione ho imparato molte cose. È per questo che viaggio così spesso. Puoi insegnarmi qualcosa di nuovo?
\rFannie: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Reliquia.

id: \rTM101 contains Confuse Ray. It will confuse the opponent.
en: \rTM101 contains Confuse Ray. It will confuse the opponent.

id: \rI would suggest you go visit Byron, the Canalave Gym Leader. You can get there by heading west of Jubilife.
en: \rI would suggest you go visit Byron, the Canalave Gym Leader. You can get there by heading west of Jubilife.
it: \rTi suggerisco di andare a trovare Ferruccio, il Capopalestra di Canalipoli. Ci arrivi andando a ovest di Giubilopoli.

id: \rFantina: I look forward to seeing you soar through the competition. Don't let me down.
en: \rFantina: I look forward to seeing you soar through the competition. Don't let me down.
it: \rFannie: Non vedo l'ora di vederti volare sopra la concorrenza. Non deludermi.

id: \bFantina is in one of these rooms. Choose wrong and you will face a Trainer instead.
en: \bFantina is in one of these rooms. Choose wrong and you will face a Trainer instead.
it: \bFannie si trova in una di queste stanze. Se sbagli, dovrai affrontare un Allenatore.

id: \bI wish I was strong enough to only use two Pokémon.
en: \bI wish I was strong enough to only use two Pokémon.
it: \bVorrei essere abbastanza forte da usare solo due Pokémon.
